description:
PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: F-006220-24
SHERIFF’S NO.: 25000105
Plaintiff:
NEW REZ LLC d/b/a SHELLPOINT MORTGAGE SERVICING
Vs
Defendant:
ADELEKE AKEJU; ABIMBOLA AKEJU a/k/a ABLMBOLA AKEJU
By virtue of the above stated Foreclosure to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, July 8, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: 29 WEST MADISON STREET PAULSBORO, NJ 08066 and LOT 7, BLOCK 63
ALL THAT CERTAIN LAND AND PREMISES SITUATED IN THE BOROUGH OF PAULSBORO, COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER, STATE OF NEW JERSEY, BEING MORE PARTICULARLY DESCRIBED AS:
LOT: 7, BLOCK 63
OCCUPANCY STATUS: TENANT OCCUPIED ON THE TAX MAP OF THE BOROUGH OF PAULSBORO
NEAREST CROSS STREET: APPROXIMATELY 35.00FT TO THE NEAREST CROSS STREET KNOWN AS SPRUCE STREET
APPROCIMATE DIMENSIONS: 110.22 FT x 56FT x 110.22FT x 56 FT
BEING MORE COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
29 WEST MADISON STREET
PAULSBORO, NJ 08066
THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF GLOUCESTER COUNTY IN DEED BOOK 5879, AT PAGE 318
APPROXIMATE UPSET AMOUNT $196,637.65 FOR THE SHERIFF SALE.
PURSUANT TO A MUNICIPAL TAX SEARCH DATED MAY 5, 2026
SUBJECT TO:
2026 1ST QUARTER TAXES DUE 2/1/2026, $1,072.34 OPEN PLUS PENALTY OWED IN ARREARS
2026 2ND QUARTER TAXES DUE 5/1/2026, $1,024.19 OPEN
WATER: ACCT. 18030-0, $119.00 OPEN, $425.93 OPEN PLUS PENALTY;
SEWER: ACCT. 18030-0, $131.00 OPEN , $480.81 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $156,758.60
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: May 14, 2026
Firm: HILL WALLACK LLP
Judgement Date: 12/10/2024
